candidate.definition_en: Twice the amount, size, or number of something.
candidate.explanation_ar: ضِعف الشيء، أي مقداره أو كميته مرتين.

senses.definition_en: Twice the amount, size, or number of something.
senses.explanation_ar: ضعف الكمية أو المقدار (مرتان قدر الشيء).
examples: She earns double what I do for the same work.
To pay double for the same ticket is completely unfair.
We cooked enough food for ten guests, which was double what we needed.
